controllers.title: Controllers
controllers.empty.title: No controllers
controllers.empty.text: Here you’ll see each connected controller, its battery and its buttons. There are none right now. Turn one on or connect it by cable or Bluetooth.
controllers.pressToUse: To test a controller or choose its profile, press any button on it.
controllers.test.title: Test the buttons
controllers.test.wait: Press any button on this controller to test it.
controllers.profilesInfo: A profile says what each button does. You can give each controller a different one.
controllers.lockedInfo: This profile is built in and can’t be changed. Duplicate it to adjust it to your liking.
controllers.opt.swapSub: Japanese style: B accepts and A goes back.
controllers.opt.repeatSub: How fast it moves when you hold a button.
controllers.opt.zoneSub: How far you must move the stick for it to count.
controllers.opt.invertSub: Stick up goes down, stick down goes up.
controllers.missing.title: This profile no longer exists
controllers.missing.text: It may have been deleted. Choose another one from the profile list.
controllers.nameInfo: Press A on the name to open the keyboard. Press START when you’re done.
controllers.del.title: Delete the “{name}” profile?
controllers.del.text: Controllers that used it will switch to the Standard profile. This can’t be undone.
controllers.cap.title: Button for “{action}”
controllers.cap.timeoutText: The button stays as it was. You can try again.
controllers.cap.press: Press the button you want to use…
controllers.cap.dpad: The D-pad is for moving around. Choose another button.
controllers.cap.exitInfo: To exit without changing anything, hold any button for 1 second.
